name: Rosey
source:
Race: Female Half Demon
Hobby: Counting money
Job: Restaurant owner

The owner of Rosey's Restaurant, bossy and eccentric, Rosey is known for her double personality and money-loving persona. Her favorite creation is Chocolate Egg Tart.
